post.description:
Queue one company for career-page scanning (verified websites only).

Unverified websites are verified first; the company is queued automatically if
verification succeeds.

get.description: Slow or failing sites: error streaks, rate limits, high latency.
Everything needed to understand why a company yields (no) postings.

Filters combine with AND; several values of one filter combine with OR. Unknown values never match a
filter unless named in ``include_unknown``. Pagination is keyset based and stable while data changes.
